jobs.description:
You will be a member of our SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.
• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.
• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.
• You contribute to achieving targets.
• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.
• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  
• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  
• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.
• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).

Are you interested in a job as Powder Coater? And are you ready for a quick start? Then read further!
For a company located in Wingene, we are looking for a Powder Coater!

What are your tasks?

• Prepare and cleane the metal parts
• Hang or position items that need to be coated
• Apply the powder coating by spraying
• Perform quality checks 
• Operate the curing oven
Hours: day hours Monday to Friday, often working on Saturdays

Who are you?

• You have experience in production, preferably as powder coater or within a company of sorts
• You speak English or Polish 
• You have your own transportation
• You are available quickly

For our client, a company in the Ghent region that operates in the steel industry, we are looking for an experienced and motivated Overhead Crane Operator.

Your tasks: 

• You will be responsible for lifting and moving steel plates using the overhead crane.
• You will work independently.
• You must not be afraid of heights and must have good depth perception.
• You have to load the trucks with metal parts.
• Correctly positioning the metal coils in the warehouse. 
Who are you?
• You speak English well
• You live within a 30-km radius of Evergem and have your own transport. 
• You enjoy working independently and do so effectively, are not afraid of heights, and have good depth perception.
• You are a hard worker.
• Experience as a crane operator.

Do you like to roll up your sleeves? 

And are you looking for a flexible job that fits your lifestyle?

Then SD Worx Jobs is the right place for you

SD Worx Jobs is looking for a logistics associate for a client located in Kruisem. 

Your tasks will be as follows:

• Helping to prepare orders with a scanning system

• Packing goods

• Labelling and marking 

• Performing quality checks

• You speak and understand English.

• Preferably, you have experience as an order picker.

Your future job

As a production operator, you’ll provide support to the press operator during the production process. You’ll make sure that the glue goes into the correct glue tank and closely monitor the glue levels. In addition, you’ll welcome drivers and direct them to the right location.

You’ll also be responsible for maintenance tasks and cleaning the equipment, ensuring everything runs safely and smoothly.

In short: a varied role where you play an important part in keeping the production process efficient and well-organized!

Who are you?

• 
You speak good English and can communicate easily on the work floor.

• 
You’re not afraid of physical work and like to get things done.

• 
You don’t mind getting your hands dirty.

• 
You’re motivated to work in a 6-shift system.

Location: Kluisbergen
Industry: Rubber Manufacturing
Work Schedule: 2 shifts (early & late)

We are a well-established rubber manufacturing company based in Kluisbergen, specialized in the production of high-quality rubber products for various industrial applications. Due to continued growth, we are looking for a motivated Production Operator to strengthen our team.
Your Responsibilities
• 
Operating and monitoring production machines

• 
Setting up machines according to production parameters

• 
Performing quality checks on finished products

• 
Identifying and reporting technical or production issues

• 
Ensuring a safe, clean, and organized working environment

Ready to take charge of your own CNC machine and produce high-quality parts?

For our client located in Bredene, we are looking for a CNC TURNER.

As a CNC TURNER in the Bredene region, you will perform the following tasks:

  • You will sometimes produce small series of parts, while other times you will make unique, customer-specific pieces;
  • You will work on a wide range of components, from large rollers and large-diameter parts to wear sleeves for pumps and parts for combine harvesters;
  • You will start with smaller pieces and gradually grow into working on larger components;
  • To work efficiently, you can read and understand technical drawings;
  • You manufacture unique parts based on technical drawings, with little repetitive series work;
  • You accurately measure and check finished products.
As a CNC TURNER in the BREDENE region, you can identify with the following:

  • You have experience as a conventional turner, milling machine operator or CNC turner? Great, we are looking for you!
  • We have approximately 25 machines. You will not have a fixed workstation but will learn to operate almost all of them. You will start on a standard lathe and gradually develop your skills;
  • You can read and understand technical drawings;
  • You speak Dutch or English.

Do you have a technical mindset?Are you passionate about machines and technology? Do you live near Waregem? 
Then this opportunity is for you!

For a leading company specialized in certified labels, we are looking for a Technical Operator in 2 Shifts or a Fixed Morning Shift!

What are your tasks?

• Operating complex machines on the production line
• Setting temperatures
• Setting parameters
• Filling machines with very precise quantities of materials
• Adhering to strict safety regulations

Who are you?

• You have a strong technical background, gained through education or work experience. 
• You speak Nederlands or English.

• Experience in this sector is a plus!

Do you enjoy physical work and don't mind working in a cold environment? Are you comfortable working in the meat industry (pork)? Then this opportunity could be perfect for you!

For our client’s deboning department, we are looking for a motivated employee with experience as a butcher, meat deboner, or within the meat processing industry.

Your Profile

Your Responsibilities

We are looking for Motivated Packers of rice cookies!
We are urgently looking for people who can support our client in Zottegem. 

If you know how to tackle things, read on further! 

What are our expectations? 
• You are responsible for packing food products.

Are you passionate about transport and logistics? Bleckmann is looking for you! 

We are looking for logistics employees for the Bleckmann warehouses in Rieme and Desteldonk (near Ghent). You will be working in the morning shift (05u48 - 13u48) or late shift (14u00 - 22u00).

Are you interested in this opportunity? Be sure to read this vacancy!

Tasks:

Do you have experience as an operator?

For a company in Kluisbergen we are looking for a logistic operator. 

You will work in two shifts. 

• experience as forklift driver
• experience as operator

We’re looking for people who enjoy doing hands-on work!This position is with a company that specializes in ham production.The company is located in Oudenaarde and is looking for employees to work in two shifts.

Who are you?

jobs.occupation: B Driver with progression to CE
jobs.description:
Do you want to become a truck driver and gradually work your way up to a CE driving licence? With our client, you will have the opportunity to learn the profession and develop your skills step by step.

As a B driver for this major logistics company, you will help ensure that food products are delivered safely and on time to customers every day. You will start by making deliveries with a van and receive guidance and training to obtain your CE driving licence.

- You drive a van as a B driver and make deliveries
- You learn the routes, customers and working methods
- You actively help with loading and unloading goods
- You check your load and ensure correct delivery
- You are in daily contact with customers and represent the company
- You follow training to progress to a CE driver position
- You accurately complete transport documents
- You work according to all safety and hygiene regulations

You will join a professional environment where you are guided step by step in your development. This is your opportunity to become a skilled truck driver with plenty of opportunities for further growth.

During the onboarding period, you will work in the warehouse in a two-shift system. If this period goes well, you will start the training and receive a contract with the company.
- Vaardigheden:
You are motivated to become a truck driver
You are open to a training programme towards obtaining your CE driving licence
You are responsible and calm in traffic
You are customer-friendly and communicate fluently
You work accurately and have a strong focus on safety

- Attesten:
You hold a valid B driving licence.

- Opleidingsvereisten:
/

- Vakkennis:
Previous experience as a driver is an advantage

- Talenkennis:
You speak and understand English well

For a company in the Waregem region, we are looking for an all-round (multi-skilled) employee. You will work in a company that processes second-hand clothing.

What does the job involve?

• You assist with the initial sorting process (on top of the sorting installation).
• You are responsible for removing and transporting the initially sorted items.
• You assist our drivers with manual unloading.

• Dynamic
• Good physical condition
• Insightful, able to work independently
• No dust allergy
• Forklift experience + certificate = a plus
• You speak French / English or Dutch fluently

Are you looking for a new challenge that will (fork)lift your spirits? Be sure to read further! 
We are looking for an experienced Forklift Driver for a company specialized in the construction and interior sector. 

What are your tasks? 

• Responsibility of operating the line
• Safely but quickly move goods on and off trucks using a forklift
• Place items in the correct storage locations and stack them securely
• Move pallets and products between the dock, warehouse, and storage areas
• Respect safety rules, wear protective equipment, and ensure a safe working environment

What do we expect from you? 

• You are a motivated candidate who is ready to pick up their new tasks quickly
• You have broad experience as a forklift driver
• You are in possession of a forklift certificate
• You have your own car
• You speak English well
• You are aware of the importance of following health and safety guidelines

Are you looking for a varied job where you can both apply your technical knowledge and carry out practical tasks?

Then be sure to apply for this operator position!

You will be working in a food company specialized in the processing and storage of a wide range of food products.

As an operator, you are responsible for the smooth running of the production process and ensure that your machines continue to operate efficiently.
You do this by:

• Correctly setting machine parameters

• Monitoring quality and making adjustments to the machine when necessary

• Assisting with machine changeovers for new products

• Independently resolving minor technical malfunctions

• Correctly replenishing supplies

• Cleaning the machines

• Consulting with technicians, packaging staff, team leaders, and others

All of this takes place in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C), working in a three-shift system, while strictly adhering to hygiene and safety regulations.

You have relevant work experience and/or a technical background (e.g. through training or education).

You take pride in keeping your machine running smoothly and in resolving minor breakdowns or blockages quickly and efficiently.

You are flexible and willing to work shifts: early/late and night.

Working in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C) does not deter you.

You are able to work independently, but you also regularly consult with colleagues to ensure a smooth production process.

You do not mind performing physical work.

You have a good command of Dutch and/or English and are able to commute independently to Dendermonde.

Forum is looking for Operators in Zottegem urgently! 
Your responsibilities:

• You will be responsible for setting up, operating, and reconfiguring production equipment on a production line.
• You will be able to work on various machines.
• You will clean the machines, equipment, and conveyor belts.

Who are you?

• You have a technical background, either through a degree or work experience
• You have some initial experience as a technical operator
• You are motivated
• You have a consistent work history
• You speak English well

As a Junior International Account Manager, you will be responsible for developing and managing relationships with clients across international markets while identifying new business opportunities and driving growth.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

Join a dynamic and fast-growing international company where innovation, entrepreneurship, and ambition are at the heart of everything. You'll have the opportunity to build a global network, make a real impact, and accelerate your career in an inspiring environment.

Omschrijving

• Build and maintain strong relationships with existing clients.
• Develop and manage your own client portfolio.
• Identify and approach new business opportunities.
• Understand clients' needs and provide tailored solutions.
• Conduct market research and monitor industry trends.
• Negotiate commercial agreements and close deals.
• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure excellent customer satisfaction.
• Represent the company during meetings, events, and client visits.

• Bachelor's degree minimum.
• Fluent in French or Dutch, with a good command of English.
• Ambitious, energetic, and driven by results.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• Not afraid of client contact or commercial challenges.
• Entrepreneurial mindset with a proactive attitude.
• Eager to learn and build a successful career in sales and account management.
